[.walkthrough]
.Find your way around the toolbar
. The [.walkthrough-look]#Copilot toolbar# sits in the lower-right corner of your app. It stays small and faded until you move the pointer toward it.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/toolbar/01-where.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/toolbar/01-where.jpg"]
. Pick a mode. *Inspect* shows the view's structure, *Edit* lets you change it, *Test* checks it, and *Play* is your app as usual. The toolbar grows the panels of the mode you pick.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/toolbar/02-modes.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/toolbar/02-modes.jpg"]
. The *⋮* menu has your app's info and log, feature flags, user impersonation, feedback, and settings.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/toolbar/03-menu.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/toolbar/03-menu.jpg"]
